label: RB951-2n
description: MikroTik RB951-2n (RB951-2n) — 5x 100M RJ45, Wi-Fi 2.4 GHz. MIPSBE 1-core AR9331.
notes: Inlet is eth1, and this board sources nothing. https://mikrotik.com/product/RB951-2n (read 2026-11-28): "Number of DC inputs 1", "PoE in Passive PoE", no PoE-out row. https://cdn.mikrotik.com/web-assets/product_files/rb951-2n_130506.pdf (product datasheet): "PoE: 8-30V DC on Ether1 (Non 802.3af). Jack: 8-30V DC", "Power consumption Up to 3W". The 2014 quick guide on the same CDN prints no consumption figure, and an older quick guide prints 7 W under maximum load, so the datasheet figure is recorded and the divergence is noted rather than averaged. eth1 draws 3 W; eth2-eth5 are poeIn: false.
